channel.title: Brio
channel.description: Updates for Brio, the macOS menu-bar developer toolbox.

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.10
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.9

  • Match the nested-row gate's nil fallback to the toggle above it
  • Document the Keep Awake menu toggle
  • Add a screen-on toggle to the Keep Awake menu
  • Cover the no-op display-sleep write while a session is active
  • Let the controller own the screen-on setting outright
  • Give KeepAwakeController the screen-on key
  • Plan the Keep Awake menu toggle
  • Complete the deletion list in the keep-awake menu spec
  • Design a screen-on toggle for the Keep Awake menu
  • Untrack the SDD scratch ledger
  • Record the appcast hosting lesson
  • Fix RELEASES_TOKEN docs for the single-repo appcast move
  • Point the updater at the Pages-hosted appcast
  • Publish the appcast to brio-releases instead of the site repo
  • Validate the feed by text match rather than an XML parse
  • Plan the appcast hosting move
  • Design moving the Sparkle appcast off the Netlify site build

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.9
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.8

  • Size the Settings window to the taller Keep Awake tab
  • Attach each subtitle to its control instead of giving it a row
  • Document the Keep Awake settings grouping
  • Group the Keep Awake settings into three sections
  • Read the display settings positively without migrating them
  • Plan the Keep Awake settings UX pass
  • Design the Keep Awake settings UX pass
